csv_project_name: Design for TH 52 ADA & Sidewalk Improvements
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Minnesota , Department of Transportation , may be seeking a Consultant to provide design for DA and sidewalk improvements along Trunk Highway (TH) 52 in Olmsted County. The project will address ADA improvements, sidewalk and trail repairs, and geometric and operational enhancements along TH 52 from the 75th Street Interchange to the Mayowood Road overpass bridge in Rochester, MN. Work includes upgrades to pedestrian ramps, frontage road connections, bituminous trail segments, and intersections requiring ADA compliance, drainage evaluation, geometric refinements, and potential signal modifications as identified during MnDOT s scoping process. Services will include, but are not limited to, project management, environmental documentation, development of construction limits, design memoranda, intersection control evaluation (ICE) as needed, preliminary and final Level 2 geometric layouts, drainage design, traffic management planning, roadway design, traffic engineering, ADA design, lighting design, signing and pavement marking design, utility coordination, special provisions, cost estimates, preparation of the final plan package, and construction support services. The Consultant will coordinate with MnDOT functional groups including Surveys, Environmental, Water Resources, Traffic, Bridge/Structures, Materials, Right of Way, Construction, and Maintenance as well as the City of Rochester and Olmsted County.
